Presence: the Chen 2017 annotation's Name-All column (data/sherlock/Sherlock_Segments_1000_NN_2017.tsv) counts as HumanReviewed presence for the body-scene rows; receipt cites TSV checksum, row and column. Recorded caveat: it names characters, so unnamed extras may be absent, and segments are coarse.
2. Tracker deferred, not dropped: filed as its own bead under S3. S3c uses existing frame observations; frame pairs stay contributory AppearanceMatch.
3. Spend: USD 5 ceiling for the round, dated deepseek-v4.1-flash pin, fallback off, ZDR, recorded and replayable; LLM proposals only, the resolver decides.
Survey facts: body depicted at part-2 84-94 s (row 503), 110-111 (507), 152-155 (526); "There's a woman lying dead" at 250.02-250.96 s (row 575) while Name-All lists only John, so deixis cannot license that link; expected Open unless a NamedReference or another utterance licenses it.
